scope: 12 NEW learning-algorithm sources beyond v2; broad actor-update design, no training

sources.title: Simple Policy Optimization
read_scope: Full method sections 3–5
Section 6 experiments and comparisons
Official MuJoCo trainer policy loss
sources.physical_robot_scope: No physical robot experiment identified in reviewed article; MuJoCo and Atari.
method_and_limits: Ratio objective rA-|A|(r-1)^2/(2 epsilon).
Per-sample ratio alignment is not a global guarantee for approximate neural optimization.
Suitable low-cost direct replacement baseline; paper says only loss differs in matched comparisons.

sources.title: Absolute Policy Optimization: Enhancing Lower Probability Bound of Performance with High Confidence
read_scope: Sections 2–4 objective, bounds, practical approximations
Section 5.7 PAPO and computational comparisons
sources.physical_robot_scope: Continuous-control, GUARD and Atari benchmarks; no physical deployment claimed here.
method_and_limits: Objective is J-k Var(return), not CVaR(cost).
Probability guarantee uses variance assumptions; practical maxima/constants are approximated.
PAPO implementation described in article as multiple SGD steps with mean-KL early stopping.

sources.title: Model-based Reinforcement Learning with Scalable Composite Policy Gradient Estimators
read_scope: Sections 3–4 estimator derivation and intermediate-node covariance combination
Sections 5–6 experiments
Discussion of Dreamer-specific gradient bias and comparison metric
sources.physical_robot_scope: DreamerV1 visual-control simulations and synthetic systems; no physical robot result claimed.
method_and_limits: Combines local likelihood-ratio and reparameterization estimators coordinatewise, including covariance.
Avoids computing all per-sample full-parameter gradients.
Dreamer LR/RP variants need not have identical means due to implementation bias.
Sample-dependent variance weights do not imply finite-sample unbiasedness.

sources.title: Policy Optimization in Hybrid Discrete-Continuous Action Spaces via Mixed Gradients
sources.venue: arXiv v1; official NeurIPS 2026 manuscript available
sources.read_version: Deep read arXiv 2605.14297v1 (HPO); official NeurIPS manuscript uses MGPO name
read_scope: Sections 2–3 full formulation, gradient theorem and pseudocode
Sections 4–5 experiments, cross-term ablation and near-best-response conditions
Official source structure and log-probability entry points located
sources.physical_robot_scope: Joint inventory replenishment and switched LQR; no legged hardware experiments.
method_and_limits: Discrete score gradient, continuous pathwise term, plus continuous-to-future-discrete-probability cross term.
Theory needs differentiable fixed-mode dynamics and regularity.
Dropping cross term justified only under near-best-response/sensitivity assumptions, not arbitrary contact switching.
Practical version uses PPO epochs for discrete component and one continuous mixed-gradient update.
sources.code_audit: Repository pinned; hybrid_agent log-probability and output paths located, not a full training-loop audit

sources.title: Rectified Robust Policy Optimization for Model-Uncertain Constrained Reinforcement Learning without Strong Duality
read_scope: Section 3 nonzero duality gap example
Section 4 algorithms, natural policy update, assumptions and corrected convergence bound
Sections 5–6 gridworld and extended robust-control experiments
sources.physical_robot_scope: Gridworld and Robust HalfCheetah with energy constraint; no real robot.
method_and_limits: Primal-only threshold/constraint/objective rectification.
Requires robust-value approximation accuracy and worst-case exploration/coverage.
Corrected convergence rate retains O(uncertainty-set diameter), not exact general convergence.
Nonzero duality gap does not mean all practical primal-dual procedures necessarily fail.

sources.title: ContractionPPO: Certified Reinforcement Learning via Differentiable Contraction Layers
sources.venue: arXiv; Caltech publication list says RA-L to appear 2026
sources.read_version: Downloaded arXiv PDF on 2026-11-26; Theorem 1 visually verified on page 5
read_scope: Sections III–V full method and hardware experiments
PDF page 5 rendered and visually checked for theorem inconsistencies
Official contraction_metric.py and contraction_ppo.py core update paths
sources.physical_robot_scope: Unitree Go1, handstand/moving platform and disturbance experiments; not general hybrid-locomotion certification.
method_and_limits: Theorem 1 contains +alpha residual versus -alpha upper bound, general eigenvalue/norm equality error, and differing m_min factors. Do not inherit certification theorem as written.
Official metric code uses positive diagonal softplus plus floor; strict PD is actually handled.
Actor uses detached contraction-shaped rollout reward; direct contraction loss addend in PPO update is commented out in audited pin.
No implementation execution or reproduction performed.
sources.code_audit: Core metric parameterization, detached metric optimizer, PPO loss and process_env_step reward integration inspected

sources.title: Contraction-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Nonlinear Control with Statistical Robustness
sources.venue: IEEE Transactions on Robotics, Early Access
read_scope: Section IV algorithm, pretrained dynamics, metric generator and freeze-and-learn
Section V deterministic-optimum and statistical robustness assumptions
Experimental settings and baseline distinctions
sources.physical_robot_scope: Simulated and real nonlinear path tracking, as reported; not a contact-rich gait-switching theorem.
method_and_limits: Pretrained dynamics used for metric generator, not directly for actor policy optimization.
Metric generator is stochastic and entropy-regulated; policy learns metric-conditioned tracking reward.
Theory assumes a contracting reference policy and ideal optimal policy; statistical claims need exchangeable calibration.
Finite PPO training does not establish these ideal properties.

sources.title: Dream-MPC: Gradient-Based Model Predictive Control with Latent Imagination
read_scope: Section 4 full method and algorithm
Section 5 comparisons, ablations and inference times
Interpretation of TD-MPC2 versus BMPC proposal quality
sources.physical_robot_scope: 24 simulated DMC/Meta-World/HumanoidBench tasks, plus visual control; no physical robot benchmark in reviewed paper.
method_and_limits: Few policy-generated sequences refined by model gradient, action reuse, Q-ensemble uncertainty regularization.
Fewer forward evaluations are not proportional wall-clock savings because gradients and execution overhead matter.
Official results: strong with BMPC; cannot consistently match MPPI with TD-MPC2.
RTX 4090 inference measurements do not establish onboard hard-real-time performance.

sources.title: Reusing Trajectories in Policy Gradients Enables Fast Convergence
read_scope: Sections 3–4 dependence, target/cross-time bias and MPM estimator
Sections 5–7 regularity, divergence, complexity and experiments
Appendix environment/policy configuration selectively read
sources.physical_robot_scope: CartPole, Swimmer and HalfCheetah simulations; no robot.
method_and_limits: Power-mean corrected importance weights bounded by inverse correction coefficient.
Controls bias with concentration/covering arguments; does not assert generic adaptive replay is unbiased.
Needs bounded log-policy derivatives and trajectory-distribution chi-square divergence assumptions.
Theory for stationary-gradient accuracy is not PPO monotonic-improvement guarantee.

sources.title: Bootstrapped Model Predictive Control
sources.read_version: ICLR proceedings PDF; arXiv first submission 2025-03-24
read_scope: Section 4 full algorithm, imitation objective, model-based TD and lazy reanalyze
Section 5 ablations and wall time
Official policy KL, critic target and reanalyze implementation
sources.physical_robot_scope: DMC/HumanoidBench and other simulated control; no physical robot result attributed.
method_and_limits: Planner imitator improves policy prior, which improves subsequent planner.
Model-generated TD uses current policy; practical TD horizon 1 limits model compounding error.
Lazy reanalyze keeps planner distributions in replay.
Paper expert-to-policy KL versus audited code policy-to-expert KL must be distinguished.
sources.code_audit: bmpc/bmpc.py update_pi/_td_target_V/reanalyze and common/math.py kl_div inspected; no execution

sources.title: CrossQ: Batch Normalization in Deep Reinforcement Learning for Greater Sample Efficiency and Simplicity
read_scope: Introduction and method structure
UTD/computation comparisons and benchmark scope
Not full appendix/proof audit
sources.physical_robot_scope: Continuous-control benchmarks; citations to earlier SAC/DroQ real robots do not constitute CrossQ hardware evidence.
method_and_limits: Careful batch normalization and no target network with wider critic support low UTD=1.
Use as modern off-policy compute baseline, not claim all additional gains require model learning.

sources.title: Risk-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Bandit-Based Adaptation for Quadrupedal Locomotion
sources.venue: ICRA 2026; publisher and author lab confirm
read_scope: Sections III–V CVaR, PPO/Lagrange update and empirical-Bernstein UCB
Sections VI–VII training, OOD settings, Go2 outcomes
Section VIII limitations
sources.physical_robot_scope: Unitree Go2 flat ground, ramp and grass/hidden soft cones; risk level varies mobility and survival.
method_and_limits: Family of return-CVaR constrained policies, selected online by episodic return UCB.
Very conservative policy can stop progressing on ramp or hidden cones.
Bandit assumes sufficiently stable returns and does not optimize execution risk directly.
Mean reward, failure cost, progress and CVaR must be distinct project metrics.
